# Vision Dynamics

[Vision Dynamics](https://visiondynamics.ch) is a premier Web3 development and research collective specializing in high-performance blockchain infrastructure, advanced indexing solutions, and next-generation decentralized applications (dApps).

With deep-rooted expertise spanning multiple Web3 ecosystems, we are dedicated to building robust, user-centric platforms—with a specialized focus on scaling and supporting the **ZERA Network**.

## 🚀 Our Core Products

We are the makers behind critical infrastructure and consumer-facing applications that power the decentralized web:

### [Vision Hub](https://visionhub.ch)

The central command center for our self-custody Web3 ecosystem. Vision Hub delivers an elegant, high-fidelity transaction experience, multi-chain dApp browser, cross-chain bridging, and state-of-the-art token swap mechanisms.

### [Zerascan.io](https://zerascan.io)

Our advanced ZERA Network Explorer. Zerascan provides comprehensive real-time network telemetry, deep transaction forensics, and developer-grade insights into the ZERA blockchain architecture.

### [Indexer API](https://zerascan.io/api)

Our advanced ZERA Network Indexer API provides comprehensive real-time network telemetry, deep transaction forensics, and developer-grade insights into the ZERA blockchain architecture. It's the powerhouse behind Vision Hub, Zerascan, and available to other dApps waiting to build on the ZERA Ecosystem.

### Open Source Contributions

We are committed to the open-source ecosystem and contribute to various projects, including this zera.js SDK.

### And Much More

We design and architect cutting-edge dApps and work with other teams to help them scale and support your platforms.

Our team brings extensive, battle-tested engineering experience to complex Web3 systems. We excel in:
